58:1: Niɣ Isla Ṛebbi i wawal n tin i k d ihedṛen ɣef urgaz is. Teţcetkay i Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi Isla i umeslay nnwen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Isell, Iẓeṛ.
58:2: Wid iţmettilen tilawin nnsen ar izugar n tyimmatin nnsen, ur llint d tiyimmatin nnsen - imi tiyimmatin d tid, kan, i ten id iurwen -, ihi, ar d nnan yir awal, akked tikerkas. Ih, Ṛebbi ard Win Iţsemmiḥen, Iţqilin.
58:3: Wid imetlen, akka, tilawin nnsen, sinna, wexxṛen i wayen d nnan, ad brun i wakli, uqbel a tent nnalen. D ayen uɣuṛ i kwen nuban. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen txedmem.
58:4: Win ur newɛa ara, ilaq ad iuẓum sin wagguren, wa deffir wa, uqbel a ţ innal. Win, daɣen, ur nezmir ara, ad iccečč sdiset igellilen. Akka, iwakken a ţţamnem s Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. D tigi ay d tilisa n Ṛebbi. I ijehliyen aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
58:5: Ih, wid iţqamaṛen Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, ad nneqlaben, akken nneqlaben wid i ten id izwaren. Niɣ Nessers ed issekniyen iberrzen. I ijehliyen, aɛaqeb isdullun.
58:6: Ass ideg ara ten id Issker Ṛebbi, meṛṛa, ad asen Issken ayen xedmen. Ṛebbi Iḥesb iten, nitni ţţun ten. Ṛebbi d Anagi n yal cci.
58:7: Day ur twalaḍ ara ar Ṛebbi Iẓṛa i illan di tmurt, i illan deg igenwan? Ur iţţili wawal ger kraḍ, mebla ma Illa, Neţţa, d wis kuẓ; neɣ ger smus, u Neţţa, d wis sdis. Ama seddaw, neɣ sennig waya, ad Yili yidsen, anda ma llan. Dɣa, ad asen Imel acu xedmen, ass n tnekra. Ih, Ṛebbi Iẓṛa yal cci.
58:8: Ur twalaḍ ara wid iɣef teţwagdel temlilit i umeslay, sinna, uɣalen ar wayen i sen iţwagedlen? Pţemlilin i ubekkaḍ, i wanfal, i ɛaṣṣu i Umazan. Ma usan k id, ad sellmen fellak s wayen ur d Iţsellim fellak Ṛebbi. Qqaṛen deg ulawen nnsen: "awi d kan ur aɣ Iţɛuqub ara Ṛebbi ɣef wayen neqqaṛ"! Loahennama beṛka ten. Ad ṛɣen degs. A tuɣalin icemten!
58:9: A wid iumnen! Ma temlalem i wawal, ur ţţemlilit ara i ubekkaḍ, i wanfal, i ɛaṣṣu i Umazan. Pţemlilit i tezdeg akked uḥezzeb. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi uɣuṛ ara teţwafesrem.
58:10: Timlilit i wawal si Cciṭan kan, iwakken ad ɣweblen wid iumnen. Acemma ur ten iṭṭuṛṛu, siwa ma Irad Ṛebbi. ɣef Ṛebbi ara ţţeklen lmumnin.
58:11: A wid iumnen! Ma nnan awen: "get amkan" di temliliyin, get amkan! Ṛebbi ad awen Ig amkan. Ma nnan awen: "ooet amkan", ooet amkan! Ad Issali Ṛebbi tidekkaṛin, wid iumnen segwen, akked wid iwumi teţţunefk tmusni. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen txedmem.
58:12: A wid iumnen! Ma temlalem i wawal akked Umazan, seddqet uqbel timlilit. Akka i wen ilha, i wen iṣfa. Ma ur tewɛam ara, ihi, Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
58:13: Tekukram a ţseddqem uqbel timlilit nnwen? Ma ur tseddqem ara, u Issuref awen Ṛebbi, ẓẓallet, zekkit, aɣet awal i Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen txedmem.
58:14: Day ur twalaḍ ara wid idduklen akked ugdud iɣef Izzaɛf Ṛebbi? Ur llin segwen neɣ segsen. Pgalan s tkerkas, u nitni ẓṛan.
58:15: Ihegga yasen d Ṛebbi aɛaqeb uqsiḥ. Ih, ar dir it wayen xeddmen!
58:16: ɣilen tagallit nnsen d ssṛan. Swexxiṛen seg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Fellasen aɛaqeb isdullun.
58:17: Ur sen d iţţawi acemma wayla nnsen, neɣ dderya nnsen, mgal Ṛebbi, d awezɣi. Widak d at tmes. Degs, nitni, ad wekkṛen.
58:18: Ass ideg ara ten id Issker Ṛebbi, meṛṛa, ad aS gallen akken i wen ţgallan. Ad ɣilen ar ad yili wacu ideg ara ṭṭfen. Aɛni mačči, war ccekk, nitni d ikeddaben?
58:19: Imelk iten Cciṭan armi ţţun asmekti n Ṛebbi. Widak d akabar n Cciṭan. Niɣ akabar n Cciṭan d imexsuṛen.
58:20: Ih, wid iţqamaṛen Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, widak, ad ndellen sennig wiyaḍ.
58:21: Iura Ṛebbi: war ccekk, d Nek akked imazanen iW, ara irebḥen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, d Uohid, d Uzmir.
58:22: Ur teţţafeḍ ara agdud iumnen s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru, ad iddukwel akked wid iţqamaṛen Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Xas ma llan d ibabaten nnsen, neɣ d arraw nnsen, d atmaten nnsen, d alag nnsen. Widak, Iura yasen liman deg ulawen nnsen, Iul iten s ṛṛuḥ sɣuṛeS. A ten Issekcem di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, degsen ad wekkṛen. Ṛuḍan Ṛebbi, Iṛuḍa ten. Widak d akabar n Ṛebbi. Day akabar n Ṛebbi mačči d win ara irebḥen?
59:1: Sbuccuɛen Ṛebbi kra illan deg igenwan, akked kra illan di tmurt. Neţţa d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
59:2: D Neţţa i Issuffɣen seg ixxamen nnsen wid ijehlen seg At Tezmamt, i ujemmal amezwaru. Ur tuminem ara ad ffɣen. ɣilen leswaṛ nnsen a ten sellken si Ṛebbi. Ikka yasen d Ṛebbi seg wanda ur bnin. Issekcem tugdi deg ulawen nnsen. Hudden ixxamen nnsen, s ifassen nnsen, akked ifassen n lmumnin. Meyyzet a wid iţwalin!
59:3: Lemmer ur asen Iura ara Ṛebbi neffu, yili Iqeṭṭa ten di ddunit, u, di laxeṛt, fellasen aɛaqeb n tmes.
59:4: Ayagi, acku numren Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Win inumren Ṛebbi, ihi, Ṛebbi, Iwɛaṛ i uqeṭṭi.
59:5: Ayen tgezmem n tezdayin akked wayen teooam beddent af iẓuṛan nnsent, s wannuf n Ṛebbi, iwakken a d Isdull iballaɣen.
59:6: Ayen i s Ifka Ṛebbi, sɣuṛsen, i Umazan iS, ur tebgisem fellas s ioedɛen akked lemrakeb. Maca, Ṛebbi Iţţak adabu i Umazan iS, ɣef wid i S ihwan. Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci.
59:7: Ayen Ifka Ṛebbi i Umazan iS, sɣuṛ at tuddar, n Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, llezm is, igujilen, imeɣban, akked win d ibbwi ubrid. Iwakken ur iţţuɣal ara ger ifassen imeṛkantiyen nnwen. Ayen i wen ifka Umazan, ddmet eţ. Ayen i wen ikkes, kkset eţ. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi, Iwɛaṛ i uqeṭṭi.
59:8: I igellilen iminigen, id ssuffɣen seg ixxamen nnsen akked seg wayla nnsen, ssaramen lfeḍl n Ṛebbi akked llza, fkan afus i Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, d widak ay d imawlan n tideţ.
59:9: Wid izedɣen ixxamen, iumnen uqbel nnsen, ḥemmlen wid id iunagen ɣuṛsen. Ur nẓifen idmaren nnsen af wayen i sen iţţunefken, smenyafen ten i iman nnsen, xas ma gwran d xuṣṣen. Wid irran akin ccḥa af yiman nnsen, widak d imerbaḥ.
59:10: Wid id iusan deffir sen, qqaṛen: "a Mass nneɣ! Semmeḥ aɣ, akked wamaten nneɣ, i ɣ d izwaren ar liman. Ur Pţara deg ulawen nneɣ, aɣullu n wid iumnen. A Mass nneɣ! Kečč, s tideţ, d Umɛin Iţḥunun".
59:11: Ur twalaḍ ara ixabiten, la qqaṛen i watmaten nnsen ijehlen, seg wAt Tezmamt: "ma ssuffɣen kwen, ard a neffeɣ yidwen, ur nessemḥas i yiwen, d awezɣi, mgal nnwen. Ma nnuɣen kwen, ar ad awen nefk afus". Ad Icehhed Ṛebbi, ar nitni d ikeddaben.
59:12: Ma ssuffɣen ten, ur teffɣen yidsen. Ma nnuɣen ten, ur asen ţţaken afus. Ma ɛawnen ten, ad rewlen; ihi, ur ţţɛawanen!
59:13: D kunwi, sennig Ṛebbi, ay ugaden idmaren nnsen, ayagi, acku nitni d agdud ur nefhim.
59:14: Ur kwen ţnaɣen, ddukwlen, siwa ma di temdinin iţţwaẓeṛben, neɣ deffir leswaṛ. Lbeɣwḍ garasen qesseḥ. A ţxileḍ dduklen, wanag rwin wulawen nnsen. Ayagi, acku nitni d agdud ur neţxemmim.
59:15: Cban wid i ten id izwaren s cwiṭ kan, jeṛṛben lwexda igiten nnsen, fellasen aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
59:16: Cban Cciṭan, mi s inna i umdan: "ejhel"! Mi ijhel, inna: "nek mgirrdeɣ k, nek ugadeɣ Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen"!
59:17: D times, ih, ara yilin d taggara nnsen, ad wekkṛen dinna. Ayagi d arraz imednas.
59:18: A wid iumnen! Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Yal yiwen iwata ad iwali acu ihegga i uzekka. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi Iţţuxebbeṛ ɣef wayen txeddmem.
59:19: Ur ţţilit am wid iţţun Ṛebbi. Irra ten, ţţun iman nnsen. Widak d iballaɣen.
59:20: Ur aɛdilen ara at tmes akked at Loennet. At Loennet d imerbaḥ.
59:21: Lemmer id Nessader Leqwṛan agi af udrar, a t twaliḍ iunez, ifelleq, si tugdi n Ṛebbi. D wigi ay d imedyaten id Neţţawi i medden, amar ad meyyzen.
59:22: Neţţa d Ṛebbi, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa, Amusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir. Neţţa, d Aḥnin Iţḥunun.
59:23: D Neţţa, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa, ay d Agellid, d Ssid, d Tifrat, d Bab n liman, d Aɛssas, d Uzmir, d Ajebbaṛ, d Ameqwṛaḥan. Gedha s Ṛebbi, mgal wayen ţcaraken!
59:24: Neţţa d Ṛebbi, d Axellaq, d Bab usisi, d Amessal. I Neţţa ismawen imxulaf maḍi. Sbuccuɛen T akw kra illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Neţţa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
60:1: A wid iumnen! Ur ddukulet d icenga W akked icenga nnwen. Teram ten d iḥbiben, u nitni nekṛen ayen id iusan, ɣuṛwen, n tideţ. Ẓẓaɛn Amazan, ẓẓaɛn kwen, imi tumnem s Ṛebbi, Mass nnwen. Ma teffɣem a ţţennaɣem deg ubrid iW, u teţnadim ṛṛḍa W, day a ten terrem, s tuffra, d iḥbiben? Nek, Ifeɣ akw akken Ẓṛiɣ, ayen teffrem akked wayen tennam. Win, segwen, ixedmen akka, innetlaf seg ubrid umɛin.
60:2: Ma ɣelben kwen, ad uɣalen d icenga nnwen, a kwen merten s ifassen nnsen akked yilsawen nnsen, ad ssirmen a ţjehlem.
60:3: Ass n tnekra, ur kwen infaɛ walag, neɣ tarwa nnwen, d awezɣi. Ad Ifrez garawen. Ṛebbi Iţwali igiten nnwen.
60:4: Niɣ illa i kunwi umedya ucbiḥ di Ibṛahim akked wid illan yides, mi nnan i ugdud nnsen: "nemgirred ikwen, kunwi akked wayen teţţanzem, war Ṛebbi. Nenkeṛ ikwen. Taɛdawt akked ddɣel, ersen d garaneɣ, i lebda, alamma tumnem s Ṛebbi Yiwen". Kkes ed awalen i inna Ibṛahim, i baba s: "ad ḍelbeɣ a ţţeţţusemmḥeḍ, xas ur iyi Ikellef Ṛebbi, fellak, s wacemma". A Mass nneɣ! Pţkal nneɣ fellaK; nutub iK; ɣuṛeK tuɣalin.
60:5: A Mass nneɣ ur aɣ Pţara d ahewwel i wid ijehlen. A Mass nneɣ! Semmeḥ aɣ. Ih, Kečč d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
60:6: Niɣ, i kunwi, amedya nnsen ucbiḥ, i wid iggunin Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru. Ma d win iwexxṛen, ihi, Ṛebbi d Asɛay, d Amaɛzuz!
60:7: Ahat Ṛebbi ad Irr tadukli garawen akked wid, segsen, i illan d icenga nnwen. Ṛebbi d Uzmir, Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
60:8: Ur awen Ikkis ara Ṛebbi, a ţmaɛnem u tweznem, ar wid ur kwen neţnaɣ di ddin, ur kwen nessuffuɣ seg ixxamen nnwen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iḥemmel wid iweznen.
60:9: I awen Ikkes Ṛebbi, d tadukli akked wid i kwen iţnaɣen di ddin, i kwen issuffɣen seg ixxamen nnwen, ţţaken afus mara kwen ssuffɣen. Wid iddan yidsen, widak d imednas.
60:10: A wid iumnen! Ma usant ed ɣuṛwen tid iumnen, iunagen, jeṛṛbet ţent. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa sennig akw liman nnsent. Ma tufam tent d tid iumnen, ur tent ţţarat ara i ijehliyen. Ur asen ḥellent, ur asent ḥellen. Efket asen ayen ṣṣeṛfen. Ulac uɣilif ma tuɣem tent, ma tefkam asent tuččit nnsent. Ur ţnasabet tijehliyin. Ssutret ayen tṣeṛṛfem, ad ssutren ayen ṣṣeṛfen. Akka ay d aḥuddu n Ṛebbi. Iţḥuddu garawen. Ṛebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
60:11: Ma terwel tmeṭṭut, si tlawin nnwen, ar ijehliyen, sinna, tɛaqbem, efket, ayen ṣṣeṛfen, i wid iwumi ṛṛuḥent tlawin nnsen. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, syiS ay tumnem.
60:12: A Nnbi! Ma usant ed ɣuṛek tid iumnen, ad ak gallent ur ţcarakent i Ṛebbi acemma, ur ţţakwrent, ur zennunt, ur neqqent tarwa nnsent, ur teccḍent s ifassen neɣ s iḍaṛen nnsent, ur k ţţɛuṣunt di lewqama, eṛḥeb yisent, ssuter i Ṛebbi ad asent Isemmeḥ. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
60:13: A wid iumnen! Ur ddukulet akked agdud iɣef Izzɛaf Ṛebbi. Niɣ uysen laxeṛt, akken uysen ijehliyen wid illan di tneṭlin.
61:1: Sbuccuɛen Ṛebbi, kra illan deg igenwan, akked kra illan di tmurt. Neţţa d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
61:2: A wid iumnen! Acimi id teqqaṛem ayen ur txeddmem?
61:3: D lɛaṛ meqqwṛen, ar Ṛebbi, ma teqqaṛem ayen ur txeddmem.
61:4: Ih, Ṛebbi Iḥemmel wid iţnaɣen deg ubrid iS, d ṣṣef, nitni, amzun d lebni, iẓeḍḥen.
61:5: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "a yagdud iw! Acimi la yi teṭṭuṛum, u niɣ teẓṛam nek d amazan n Ṛebbi ɣuṛwen"? Mi ffɣen i ubrid, Ṛebbi Issuffeɣ i ubrid ulawen nnsen. Ṛebbi ur Inehhu ara agdud iballaɣen.
61:6: Mi inna Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem: "A yAt Isṛail! Nek d amazan n Ṛebbi ɣuṛwen, ad tebbteɣ ayen iyi d izwaren n Tuṛa. U a kwen beccṛeɣ s Umazan ara d iasen, deffir i, ism is Aḥmed". Mi ten id iusa s ubeggen, nnan: "wagi d ssḥur n ṣṣeḥ".
61:7: Anwa idensen sennig win id igren tikerkas af Ṛebbi, u neţţa iţwanced ar wannuz? Ṛebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
61:8: Bɣan ad ssexsin tafat n Ṛebbi, s imawen nnsen. Ṛebbi ad Itim tafat iS, di nneqwma ijehliyen.
61:9: D Neţţa id Iuznen Amazan iS, s nnhaya, d ddin n tideţ, iwakken a t issifrir f ddin meṛṛa, di nneqwma ijehliyen.
61:10: A wid iumnen! Ma d awen Mleɣ ssuq ara kwen isellken seg uɛaqeb aqeṛḥan?
61:11: Amnet s Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Nnaɣet deg ubrid n Ṛebbi s wayla nnwen, u s yiman nnwen; ţţif akka i kunwi, lemmer tessinem.
61:12: Ad awen Isemmeḥ ibekkaḍen nnwen; a kwen Issekcem ar leonanat degsen isaffen ţţazzalen, tinezduɣin igerzen, di leonanat n Ɛaden; d wagi ay d rrbeḥ ameqwṛaḥan.
61:13: Ayen tḥemmlem nniḍen: afus sɣuṛ Ṛebbi akked lɣelb aqṛib. Ssefṛeḥ lmumnin.
61:14: A wid iumnen! Illit d iwiziwen n Ṛebbi, akken inna Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem, i inmahalen is: "anwi ay d iwiziwen iw ar Ṛebbi"? Nnan d inmahalen: "nekwni d iwiziwen n Ṛebbi". Tumen terbaɛt, tejhel terbaɛt, n At Isṛail. Nefka afus i wid iumnen, mgal icenga nnsen, dɣa rebḥen.
62:1: Sbuccuɛen Ṛebbi, kra illan deg igenwan, u kra illan di tmurt. Agellid, Ssid, Uzmir, Bab n ṣṣwab.
62:2: D Neţţa id Iuznen i wid ur neɣṛi, Amazan segsen, iqqaṛ asen issekniyen iS. Izizdig iten, isselmad asen Tazmamt akked ṣṣwab, xas llan, zik, di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ.
62:3: U i wid nniḍen, mara awḍen ɣuṛsen. Neţţa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
62:4: D wagi ay d lfeḍl n Ṛebbi. Iţţak it i win Ibɣa. Ṛebbi, d bab n lfeḍl ameqwṛahan.
62:5: Am wid iwumi iţţukelfen s Tuṛa, ur ţ ssawḍen. Cuban aɣyul ibubben tizmamin. I icmet umedya n ugdud inekṛen issekniyen n Ṛebbi! Ṛebbi ur Inehhu ara agdud imednas.
62:6: Ini: "a yudayen, ma tɣilem d kunwi ay d iḥbiben n Ṛebbi, war imdanen, ssutret tameţţant, ma tessawalem tideţ"!
62:7: Ur ţ ssuturen ara, d awezɣi, ilmend igiten nnsen. Ṛebbi Issen imednas.
62:8: Ini: "tameţţant iwumi tregwlem, a kwen id temmager, war ccekk. Sinna, a kwen awin ar Win Iẓṛan ayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir. Ad awen Imel ayen txeddmem".
62:9: A wid iumnen! Ma ssawlen d i tẓallit, ass unejmuɛ, ɣiwlet ar usmekti n Ṛebbi, ḥebset ttjaṛa. Pţif akka i kunwi, lemmer tessinem.
62:10: Mi tfukk tẓallit, mfaṛaqet di tmurt, nadit lfeḍl n Ṛebbi, mmektit ed aṭas Ṛebbi, amar a ţrebḥem.
62:11: Mi walan ssuq, neɣ anecṛeḥ, ad azlen ɣuṛes, a k ooen tbeddeḍ. Ini: "ayen illan ar Ṛebbi yif anecṛeḥ akked ssuq. Ṛebbi Yif akw iṛeẓẓaqen".
63:1: Ma usan d ɣuṛek ixabiten, ad ak inin: "a ncehhed ar kečč, war ccekk, d Amazan n Ṛebbi". Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ar kečč, war ccekk, d Amazan iS. Ṛebbi ad Icehhed ar, s tideţ, ixabiten d ikeddaben.
63:2: Ḥesben tagallit nnsen d laɛnaya, dɣa ssefṛaɣen abrid n Ṛebbi. Ihi, a yicmet wayen xeddmen!
63:3: Akka, acku llan umnen, sinna, jehlen. Pţuselɣen wulawen nnsen, dɣa nitni ur mḥiṣen.
63:4: Mi ten twalaḍ, a k taɛoeb tiddi nnsen. Ma mmeslayen, tessemḥaseḍ i wawal nnsen. Amzun nitni d isɣaṛen i isenden, ɣilen yal tiɣṛi fellasen. Acengu, d nitni; ḥader iman ik segsen. A ten Ineɣ Ṛebbi! Acḥal wexxṛen!
63:5: Ma nnan asen: "yyaw, ad issuter Umazan n Ṛebbi a ţţeţţusemmḥem", ad bernen iqweṛṛa nnsen, a ten twaliḍ wexxṛen s temɣweṛ.
63:6: Iɛuḍa fellasen tessutreḍ, neɣ ur tessutreḍ ad ţţusemmḥen. Ur sen Iţsemmiḥ Ṛebbi, d awezɣi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Inehhu agdud iballaɣen.
63:7: Nitni i iqqaṛen: "ur ţseddiqet, i wid iddan akked Umazan n Ṛebbi, alamma mmebruzzɛen". N Ṛebbi igerrujen igenwan akked tmurt, maca ixabiten ur mḥiṣen.
63:8: Qqaṛen: "ma nuɣal ar Lmadina, war ccekk, uzmir ad issuffeɣ, segs, uṛhif". Tazmert, n Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, akked lmumnin, maca, ixabiten ur ẓṛin.
63:9: A wid iumnen! ɣuṛwat a kwen ssbaɛden, af usmekti n Ṛebbi, wayla nnwen akked tarwa nnwen! Wid igan akka, ihi, widak d imexsuṛen.
63:10: Ssedqet seg wayen i wen Nefka, uqbel a d tas tmeţţant ar yiwen degwen, ad yini: "a Mass iw! Lemmer ad iyi Teswexxṛeḍ ar lajel aqṛib, ad seddqeɣ, ad iliɣ seg wid imaɛnen".
63:11: Ur Irennu Ṛebbi di laɛmeṛ, d awezɣi, ma iusa d lajel is. Ṛebbi Iţţuxebbeṛ ɣef wayen txeddmem.
64:1: I illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt, sbuccuɛen Ṛebbi. IneS tagelda; ineS wannuz; Neţţa Izmer i yal cci.
64:2: Neţţa ikwen Ixelqen; segwen ajehli, segwen lmumen. Ṛebbi Iţwali ayen txeddmem.
64:3: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tideţ. Imsel ikwen, Iṣeggem amsal nnwen. ɣuṛeS tuɣalin.
64:4: Iẓṛa i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Iẓṛa ayen teffrem akked wayen tennam. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa i illan deg idmaren.
64:5: Ma iusa kwen id usali n wid illan, zik, d ijehliyen? Jeṛben lwexda n tikli nnsen. Fellasen, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
64:6: Ayagi, imi sen ţţasen imazanen nnsen s ubeggen. Nnan: "aɛni d amdan ara ɣ inhun"? Dɣa jehlen, xedɛan. Ur Iclaɛ Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi d Asɛay, d Amaɛzuz.
64:7: Pţutebten ijehliyen ar, d awezɣi, ur d ţnekkaren. Ini: "xaṭi! S Mass iw, ard a d tekkrem, sinna ard a ţţeţwaxebbṛem ɣef wayen txeddmem"! Ayagi, i Ṛebbi, d ushil.
64:8: Ihi, amnet s Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, akked tafat id Nessers. Ṛebbi Iţţuxebbeṛ ɣef wayen txeddmem.
64:9: Ass ideg ara kwen Issemlil, i wass ujemmel, ass nni, d ass umɣuṛṛu. Win iumnen s Ṛebbi, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad as Ikkes tucmitin is, a t Issekcem ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, degsen ad iwekkeṛ i lebda. D wagi ay d rrbeḥ ameqwṛaḥan.
64:10: Wid ijehlen u inekṛen issekniyen nneɣ, widak d at tmes, degs ad wekkṛen. A taggara icemten!
64:11: Ur d teţţas twaɣit, siwa ma Irad Ṛebbi. Win iumnen s Ṛebbi, ad Inhu ul is. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa yal cci.
64:12: Aɣet awal i Ṛebbi, aɣet awal i Umazan! Ma twexxṛem, i iwatan kan, i Umazan nneɣ, siwa anabi iţbegginen.
64:13: Ṛebbi, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa. ɣef Ṛebbi ara ţţeklen lmumnin.
64:14: A wid iumnen! S tideţ, kra n tlawin nnwen akked tarwa nnwen, d icenga nnwen. Ḥadret iman nnwen segsen! Ma tsemmḥem, teţţum, tsemmḥem, Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
64:15: Ayla nnwen akked dderya nnwen, d ahewwel kan, wanag, ar Ṛebbi, illa warraz ameqwṛahan.
64:16: Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi ayen iwumi tzemrem. Ḥesset, ṛaḍit, seddqet! Yif it i iman nnwen. Wid ikksen ccḥa i iman nnsen, widak d imerbaḥ.
64:17: Ma tṛeḍlem i Ṛebbi aṛeṭṭal igerzen, ad awen d Irr sin imuren, ad awen Isemmeḥ. Ṛebbi Iceffu, Iḥellem.
64:18: Amusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen iḍehṛen, Uzmir, Bab n ṣṣwab.
65:1: A Nnbi! Mara tebrum i tlawin, brut asent mara tɛaddi tallit n tarda nnsent. Ḥesbet tallit. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, Mass nnwen. Ur tent ssuffuɣet si texxamin nnsent, ur d teffɣent, siwa ma, s tideţ, ccḍent. D tigi ay d tilisa n Ṛebbi. Win izegren tilisa n Ṛebbi, niɣ idens imanis. Ur teẓṛiḍ ara, ahat Ṛebbi a d Iazen lameṛ, ssyen ɣeṛ da.
65:2: Mi ssawḍent lajel nnsent, ɛacṛet ţent s lewqama, neɣ mfaṛaqet yidsent, s lewqama. Awit ed sin inagan iḥeqqiyen segwen, a d cehhden zdat Ṛebbi. Ataya wayen uɣuṛ ţţunedṛen, wid iumnen s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru. Win iţḥezziben i Ṛebbi, ad as Ildi tibbura,
65:3: a t Iɣit s wanda ur iḥtim. Win iṭṭfen di Ṛebbi, a t Iqennaɛ. Ih, Ṛebbi Issɛadday lameṛ iS. Niɣ Ṛebbi Iwzen yal cci.
65:4: I tigad, n tlawin nnwen, i iuysen tarda, ma illa ccekk, tallit ugani nnsent: kraḍ wagguren. Akken i tid ur nebdi tarda. Tid ibbwin tadist, tallit nnsent ar tinnufra nnsent. Win iţḥezziben i Ṛebbi, s lameṛ iS, ad as Istiser.
65:5: D wagi ay d lameṛ n Ṛebbi i wen d Issers. Win iţḥezziben i Ṛebbi, ad as Ikkes tucmitin is, ad Issali arraz is.
65:6: Ad asent tefkem tanezduɣt anda tzedɣem, akken tewɛam. Ur tent ṭṭuṛṛut s tririt nnsent ar lḥeṛs. Ma llant s tadist, ṣeṛṛfet fellasent, alamma d tinnufra nnsent. Ma ssuṭḍent tarwa nnwen, efket asent taqdiɛt nnsent; mwafaqet s tiẓeṭ. Ma temnamarem, a ţţessuṭṭeḍ tmeṭṭut nniḍen.
65:7: Bu udrim ad iṣeṛṛef segs. Win ixuṣ ṛṛeẓq ad iṣeṛṛef seg wayen i s Ifka Ṛebbi. Ur Iţkellif Ṛebbi taṛwiḥt, siwa ar ayen i s Ifka. Ṛebbi ad Issuffeɣ laɛtab ar tafat.
65:8: Acḥal n temdinin i inuqmen lameṛ n Mass nnsent akked imazanen iS! Nḥuseb itent leḥsab uqsiḥ. Nɛaqeb itent s uɛaqeb issexḍen.
65:9: Jeṛṛbent lwexda igiten nnsent. D lexsaṛa ay d iooa lameṛ nnsent.
65:10: Ṛebbi Ihegga yasen aɛaqeb uqsiḥ. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi a yuɛqilen iumnen! Niɣ Ṛebbi Issers awen d asmekti;
65:11: Amazan i wen immalen issekniyen n Ṛebbi iberrzen, iwakken ad Issuffeɣ, si tillas ar tafat, wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. Wid iumnen s Ṛebbi, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, a ten Issekcem ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, degsen ad wekkṛen i lebda. Niɣ Ṛebbi Igerrez asen ṛṛeẓq.
65:12: Ṛebbi i Ixelqen ṣa igenwan, akked tmurt am nitni. Lameṛ iţrusu garasen, iwakken a ţţeẓṛem ar Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci, u Ṛebbi Izzi i yal cci s tmusni.
66:1: A Nnbi! Ayɣeṛ tgedleḍ ayen i k Iḥell Ṛebbi? Tqennɛaḍ tilawin ik. Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
66:2: Ṛebbi Iḥeţţem fellawen a ţḥentem. Ṛebbi d Bab nnwen. Neţţa d Amusnaw, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
66:3: Mi inna Nnbi sser, i yiwet si tlawin is, u temla, Ṛebbi Issken it i neţţa. Ixebbeṛ s wumur, iffer amur, segs. Mi ţ iaɛlem s waya, tenna: "wi k imlan aya"? Inna: "Imla yi t Win Issnen, Iţţuxebbṛen".
66:4: Ma tutubemt Ṛebbi, ihi knan wulawen n kwent. Ma tedduklemt as, ihi, d Ṛebbi ay d Bab is, u, deffir waya, ad ilin di talalt is: Jebrayen, ṣṣam n lmumnin, u lmalayek ad fkent afud.
66:5: Ma ibra yakwent, Izmer Ṛebbi ad as d Inṣef s tlawin i kwent yifen, timḍuɛin, tid iumnen, iţẓallan, iutuben, iɛabden, iţţuẓumen, tid ijeṛben tissulya, neɣ tiɛazriyin.
66:6: A wid iumnen! Ḥadret iman nnwen akked twacult nnwen, si tmes, isɣaṛen is d imdanen akked idɣaɣen! Fellas lmalayek tuohidin, tuqsiḥin, ur neţwexxiṛ i wayen i sent Iumeṛ Ṛebbi, i ixedmen i sent iţwamṛen.
66:7: A wid ijehlen, ulayɣeṛ testeɣfṛem assa! A ţţeţţuqeṭṭim kan ɣef wayen txeddmem.
66:8: A wid iumnen! Utubet Ṛebbi, ţţuba n ṣṣeḥ! Ahat Mass nnwen ad awen Ikkes tucmitin nnwen, u a kwen Issekcem ar Loennet, ddaw as isaffen ţţazzalen. Assen, Ṛebbi ur Isdullu Nnbi akked wid iumnen yides. Tafat nnsen teţţeddu zdat sen, u yeffus nnsen. Ad qqaṛen: "a Mass nneɣ! Tim aneɣ tafat nneɣ, Semmeḥ aneɣ; ih, Kečč, Tzemreḍ i yal cci".
66:9: A Nnbi! Nnaɣ ijehliyen akked ixabiten! Iqsiḥ ɣuṛsen! Axxam nnsen d Loahennama, d tuɣalin tucmiţ.
66:10: Ifka d Ṛebbi amedya i wid ijehlen: tameṭṭut n Nuḥ akked tmeṭṭut n Luṭ. Llant ger ifassen n sin imdanen, seg wid imaɛnen n imdanen nneɣ. ɣuṛṛent ţen. Ur zmiren a tent sselken s wacemma, seg ufus n Ṛebbi. Ancad: "kecmemt ar tmes akked wid ikecmen"!
66:11: Ifka d Ṛebbi amedya i wid iumnen, tameṭṭut n Ferɛun, mi tenna: "a Mass iw! Ebnu yi, ɣuṛeK, taxxamt di Loennet, Sellek iyi si Ferɛun akked igiten is, Sellek iyi si lqum imednas"!
66:12: U Meryem ult Ɛimṛan i izazdgen tuzzuft is. Nenfes ɣuṛes si ṛṛuḥ nneɣ, teţţutebbet ɣef wawalen akked tezmamin n Mass is. Neţţat seg wid iţẓallan.
